{{Quote|The Royal Security Forces protect the Royalty of Naboo and the sector from pirates and Rebels. Their headquarters is in the capital city of Theed.|[[Trehla Keelo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TK">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=conversation|Trehla Keelo|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] '''headquarters''' was located in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. When the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] was pinned down near the building by [[P-series droideka/Legends|destroyer droids]], but was rescued by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]].

==Behind the scenes==
This building was referred to as RSF headquarters in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' indicates that the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] is the headquarters of the Security Force; this article assumes they are two separate buildings.
